summary: HR AC-04 leave approval payroll-impact metadata foundation with pure domain validation and metadata-only HR-to-payroll app envelope.

findings: The domain function has one job: validate leave decision metadata, rulepack basis, routing evidence, payroll period, and payroll-impact evidence before returning a plan.
The app function only projects a validated plan into a metadata envelope and performs no payroll calculation, storage, Workflow execution, or network I/O.

The slice creates an HR-to-payroll integration seam while preserving service ownership: HR emits evidence-backed impact metadata, payroll calculation remains a later payroll-owned adapter/domain concern.
Routing evidence and rulepack refs make delegation/escalation and labor-law basis auditable before runtime integration exists.
